label: leaf
note: PO: "a leaf in a non-vascular plant" (exact synonym phyllid); the leaf of a moss or leafy liverwort is always this subclass

label: stem
note: PO: "a stem that is part of a gametophore"; the stalk of the sporophyte is the seta, which floras name as such

label: branch
note: PO: a branch that is part of a gametophore

label: capsule fruit
note: the "capsule" of a moss is its spore capsule (PO: exact synonyms "moss capsule", "spore capsule"), not a fruit type

label: flower
note: a seed-plant organ; includes its parts (sepal, petal, stamen, ovary, style, stigma, perianth)

label: fruit
note: a seed-plant organ; includes the fruit types

label: inflorescence
note: a seed-plant structure; includes pedicel, peduncle and the inflorescence types

label: vascular leaf
note: a leaf of a vascular plant; includes petiole and leaf sheath
